title: Observation Schemes and Irregularity in Linear Dynamics
summary: We develop a structural framework for irregularity in linear dynamics centered on the space $Υ$ of observation schemes. This approach separates the underlying dynamical behavior from the observation mechanism and provides a unified setting in which classical notions such as Li--Yorke chaos, mean Li--Yorke chaos, and distributional chaos arise as particular cases corresponding to Dirac measures and Cesàro averages.
